title: Ruoth Kandalona Ogik
author: Traditional
content:
{title: Ruoth Kandalona Ogik}

{comment: Verse 1}
Ruoth kandalona ogik onego ikaw chunya.
Karingra nodong` ka anawe pinyni marach adier.
Onego adonji e piny Ruoth maler.

{comment: Chorus}
Agombo piny Ruoth maler
Agombo piny Ruoth maler
Ka anawe pinyni marach adiera,
Onego Adonji e piny Ruoth maler
Onego Adonji e piny Ruoth maler

{comment: Verse 2}
Ringruok ma an-goni ochalo gi nanga.
Onyalo ti piyo kidwaro machielo matek adier.
Onego adonjie piny Ruoth maler

{comment: Verse 3}
Ruoth ka chunya noa, ikaw chunya.
Ka ringra nodong` ka ma anawe pinyni marach adier.
Onego adonjie piny Ruoth maler.
